events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival, a pivotal moment in music history, began on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off. What's your favourite memory or performance from those three days of peace and music?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley, 49 years since we lost the King of Rock and Roll. His music still moves us today.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world remembers the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled Jimi Hendrix, 56 years since his passing. His groundbreaking guitar work continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Crossing The Road
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. What's your favourite track from this legendary album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! What's your go-to Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Mad For It Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first time you held an iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple launched the device that changed our music habits forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrated globally, James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's big screen debut with 'Dr. No' in 1962. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th Birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled their ambitious 'White Album'. A double album packed with diverse sounds - what's your top track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers the incomparable Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the extraordinary Freddie Mercury. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
